# Self Employed

> A comprehensive resource hub for self-employed professionals offering templates, tools, and curated opportunities for freelancing, gig work, and side hustles.

Self Employed provides actionable guides, free resources, and a database of income opportunities for independent workers. The site aggregates information about gig platforms, tax strategies, and business tools to help self-employed professionals manage their finances and grow their income.

## Key Topics

- Self-employed resources
- Freelancer tools
- Tax deductions
- Invoicing templates
- Side hustle database
- Gig work opportunities
- AI training jobs
- Freelance platforms
- Remote work
- Financial tracking
- Contract templates
- Business planning
- Part-time jobs
- Income boosting
- Free templates

## Core Resources & Tools

- [Free Resources & Templates for Self-Employed Professionals](https://www.selfemployed.com/resources): Free templates and tools for invoicing, tax deductions, and financial tracking

## Side Hustles & Gig Work

- [Best Side Hustles 2026](https://www.selfemployed.com/side-hustle-database): Curated database of side hustles and gig work opportunities across industries

- [About Self Employed](https://www.selfemployed.com/about-us): About Self Employed, mission, and editorial team led by Renee Johnson
